verdict.rationale: Blink's own docs show it can create multiple shells, switch between them with a swipe, and open or close tabs. That covers the multi-session core of the story. Themes and fonts are documented only as global terminal styling, and nothing shows per-session appearance or separate per-session history. Missing for 10: per-session appearance settings, per-session command history, explicit per-session context isolation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can open multiple terminal sessions, each with its own context, appearance, and history

citations.quote: To create a new shell, tap the screen with two fingers. To switch between active shells, swipe side to side.
In the bar you can: Create or Close a tab, access Snips, and toggle Lock and Geo.
Appearance: Style your terminal with themes and fonts.
